description: NaNd₃Ti₂(SbO₇)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. Na is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with six NdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four SbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.74 Å. There are three inequivalent Nd sites. In the first Nd site, Nd is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted NdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four NdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with four TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.77 Å. In the second Nd site, Nd is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted NdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four NdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four SbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.64 Å. In the third Nd site, Nd is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted NdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four NdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with four TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.65 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with four SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with six NdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-46°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.01 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with four SbO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four NdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-43°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.03 Å. There are two inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, corners with four TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four NdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-47°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.03 Å. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, corners with four TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four NdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-47°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.04 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Nd atoms to form ONaNd₃ tetrahedra that share corners with six ONaNd₃ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ONaNdSb₂ tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Nd and two Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Nd, one Ti, and one Sb atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Nd, one Ti, and one Sb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nd, one Ti, and one Sb atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nd, one Ti, and one Sb atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Nd, and two Sb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaNdSb₂ tetrahedra.
